about_short_description.short_description: Sonnet Insurance is an online insurance provider that lets user buy home and auto insurance.

product.name: Auto Insurance
product.description: Provides coverage for vehicles including liability, accident benefits, and optional add-ons like roadside assistance and vehicle replacement.

product.name: Home Insurance
product.description: Covers the structure and contents of a home, with options for additional protections like sewer backup and first claim forgiveness.

product.name: Condo Insurance
product.description: Insurance tailored for condo owners covering unit contents, liability, and special condo-related risks like unit improvements and property loss assessments.

product.name: Tenant Insurance
product.description: Provides renters with coverage for personal belongings, liability, extra living expenses, and unit improvements.

product.name: Landlord Insurance
product.description: Protects landlords with liability coverage, protection for certain property belongings, and rental income loss coverage.

product.name: Pet Insurance
product.description: Offers coverage for pet wellness, accidents, illnesses, dental care, and related veterinary expenses.
